meta.name: eol-internal-enablement
meta.description: Build the support FAQ, sales talking points, and objection handling teams need before an EOL announcement. Use when customer-facing teams must be ready before customers hear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提前备好EOL公告前的支持FAQ与销售话术
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们产品即将停售,需要让客服和销售提前做好问答和话术准备。
copy.tagline_en: Prepare support FAQs and sales talking points before EOL announcements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product is nearing end-of-life and you need to ready customer-facing teams in advance.

howto.what: 当客户支持或销售团队需要在 EOL（产品停用）公告前做好准备时，Claude 会生成一套内部材料：支持 FAQ、销售谈话要点、异议处理话术和升级路径，并根据停用影响范围选择轻量、标准或重型的详细程度。
howto.when: 当用户提出为产品停用（EOL）构建内部赋能材料，或表示客户支持/销售团队需在公告前获得准备时触发。技能会先询问产品、替代品、日期等关键信息。

say.text: 为我们的遗留模块日落构建赋能包，替代品是新控制台，年底停用。
say.note: Claude 会确认层级并生成标准材料包。

say.text: 只要支持 FAQ，针对一个功能弃用，无替代，提前三周通知。
say.note: Claude 会生成轻量级 FAQ，附升级路径。

say.text: 生成销售谈话要点和异议处理，重点应对客户说“我们刚续费”。

howto.what_en: On receiving an EOL request, Claude generates internal enablement materials: support FAQ, sales talking points, objection handling scripts, and an escalation ladder, sized to light/standard/heavy based on sunset scope.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for internal enablement materials for an EOL announcement, or when support/sales teams need to be ready before customers hear. Claude asks for product, replacement, and dates.

say_en.text: Build the enablement pack for our legacy module sunset — replaced by the new console, EOL Dec 31.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the level and builds the standard pack.

say_en.text: Support FAQ only, feature deprecation, no replacement, three weeks notice.
say_en.note: Claude produces a light FAQ with escalation path.

say_en.text: Create sales talking points and objection handling, focusing on 'we just renewed.'
